### Doing a Great Work
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/doing-a-great-work
Passage: Nehemiah 6:3
Points:
- Christian leaders frequently navigate the volatile swings of public praise and hostile criticism.
- When God's assignment nears completion, opposition often intensifies through deceptive peace offerings.
- God-given discernment enables leaders to recognize hidden danger beneath seemingly friendly overtures.
- True spiritual maturity includes the courage to say no to distractions without offering apologies.
- Remaining committed to God's calling protects believers from becoming puppets of other people.

### Are You Doing a Great Work?
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-june-25-11633797.html
Passage: Nehemiah 6:3
Points:
- The adversary continually attempts to distract believers from completing God-directed tasks.
- Nehemiah understood that sweaty, mundane construction work was genuinely a great work for God.
- Any assignment given by the Lord, no matter how unglamorous, carries eternal significance.
- Believers must reject the lie that everyday faithfulness, such as parenting or quiet service, is wasted effort.
- Performing daily duties for God's glory transforms routine labor into meaningful worship.

### Escaping a Conspiracy
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/escaping-a-conspiracy
Passage: Nehemiah 6:9
Points:
- Fierce opposition often signals the spiritual significance of the work being accomplished.
- Enemies sought to trap Nehemiah through deceptive meetings, false political rumors, and hired prophets.
- Shemaiah tried to lure Nehemiah into the temple to make him break God's law and ruin his testimony.
- Nehemiah discerned each trap and petitioned God to strengthen his hands rather than giving in to fear.
- Believers must exercise wisdom regarding who to trust while avoiding a perpetually suspicious mindset.

### Power Point - December 9, 2005
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-december-9-2005-1367645.html
Passage: Nehemiah 6:9
Points:
- Uncompromising conviction in the Lord's service frequently triggers slanderous personal assaults.
- Hostile attacks are designed to sap believers of their spiritual vitality and resolve.
- Nehemiah overcame intimidation by remaining transparent, praying for divine strength, and staying on task.
- Intimate knowledge of Scripture protects believers from being deceived by false spiritual claims.
- Clothed in God's armor, believers can persevere through opposition until God's purpose is fulfilled.
